shortDescription: Dummy Admit Card for SAV Jamui Class VI Admission 2027 is available for download. Applications were open from 03 August 2026 to 28 August 2026.
content:
Simultala Awasiya Vidyalaya (SAV), Jamui Bihar has released the Class VI admission 2027 dummy admit card for the entrance process. Candidates who have applied can use the official download link to access the dummy admit card and check the exam schedule.

The application window was open from 03 August 2026 to 28 August 2026. The school has also released the official notification and declaration form for the process.

Important Dates

  • Application begin: 03/08/2026
  • Last date to apply: 28/08/2026
  • Pre-exam date: October 2026
  • Main exam date: December 2026

Application Fee

  • General / BC / EBC / EWS: ₹200
  • SC / ST: ₹50

Age Limit

Minimum age: 10 years; maximum age: 12 years as on 01/04/2027.

Eligibility

  • Passed Class 5th
  • Studied full academic session in Classes III, IV and V
  • Meets all conditions stated in the official SAV notice

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Open the official SAV portal or dummy admit card link.
  2. Log in with the registered application credentials.
  3. Open the dummy admit card section.
  4. Download the admit card and print it.
  5. Carry the admit card and valid ID to the exam centre.

Read the full notification and declaration form before taking the entrance test.
